blocks.content: Avoiding negative marks through trap detection is as crucial as scoring correct answers.

rows: Tests direct formula or factual recall
Tests nuance, edge cases, and careful reading
Incorrect options match common calculation mistakes

items: Watch out for multi-statement questions where one minor detail renders an entire statement false.
Beware of options that give correct calculations based on wrong formula assumptions.
Always re-read the final line of the question to confirm what is explicitly being asked.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Identify and avoid common distractors designed around frequent student misconceptions.
Carefully read qualifiers in question stems such as 'NOT', 'ONLY', 'EXCEPT', and 'INCORRECT'.
Verify units, dimensions, and limits in numerical and statement-based questions.
Use the method of elimination to systematically rule out incorrect options.
